records.literal_gloss: And said to her Naomi her mother-in-law, my daughter, shall I not seek for you a resting place that it may go well for you?

en.L: And Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, so that it may go well with you?
en.B: Naomi, her mother-in-law, said to her, "My daughter, is it not time I looked for a settled home for you, where your life will go well?
en.R: One day Naomi said to Ruth, "My daughter, I want to find a husband and a home for you, where you will be safe and cared for.

sw.L: Naye Naomi mama mkwe wake akamwambia, "Binti yangu, je, nisikutafutie mahali pa raha, ili upate mema?
sw.B: Naomi, mama mkwe wake, alimwambia, "Binti yangu, je, si wakati wangu kukutafutia makao yenye utulivu, ambapo maisha yako yatakuwa mema?
sw.R: Siku moja Naomi alimwambia Ruthu, "Binti yangu, nataka kukutafutia mume na nyumba, ambapo utakuwa salama na kutunzwa.

es.L: Y Noemí su suegra le dijo: «Hija mía, ¿no he de buscarte un lugar de descanso, para que te vaya bien?
es.B: Noemí, su suegra, le dijo: «Hija mía, ¿no es hora de que te busque un hogar estable, donde te vaya bien?
es.R: Un día Noemí le dijo a Rut: «Hija mía, quiero encontrarte un esposo y un hogar donde estés segura y bien cuidada.

fr.L: Et Noémi, sa belle-mère, lui dit : « Ma fille, ne te chercherai-je pas un lieu de repos, pour que tu sois heureuse ?
fr.B: Noémi, sa belle-mère, lui dit : « Ma fille, n’est-il pas temps que je te cherche un foyer où tu sois heureuse ?
fr.R: Un jour, Noémi a dit à Ruth : « Ma fille, je veux te trouver un mari et une maison, où tu seras en sécurité et où l’on prendra soin de toi.

vi.L: Na-ô-mi, mẹ chồng nàng, nói với nàng: "Con gái của mẹ, mẹ chẳng nên tìm cho con một chốn an nghỉ, để con được hạnh phúc sao?
vi.B: Na-ô-mi, mẹ chồng nàng, nói với nàng: "Con gái của mẹ, chẳng phải đã đến lúc mẹ tìm cho con một mái ấm yên ổn, để đời con được tốt đẹp sao?
vi.R: Một ngày kia Na-ô-mi nói với Ru-tơ: "Con gái của mẹ, mẹ muốn tìm cho con một người chồng và một mái ấm, nơi con được an toàn và được chăm sóc.

ko.L: 시어머니 나오미가 룻에게 말했다. "내 딸아, 너를 위하여 안식할 곳을 찾아 주어서 네가 잘되게 해야 하지 않겠느냐?
ko.B: 시어머니 나오미가 룻에게 말했다. "내 딸아, 이제는 내가 너를 위해 편히 지낼 보금자리를 찾아 주어서, 네가 잘살게 해 주어야 하지 않겠느냐?
ko.R: 어느 날 나오미가 룻에게 말했다. "내 딸아, 나는 너에게 남편과 가정을 찾아 주고 싶다. 그러면 네가 안전하게 보살핌을 받으며 살 수 있을 것이다.

pt.L: E Noemi, a sua sogra, lhe disse: "Minha filha, não devo eu buscar para você um lugar de descanso, para que tudo lhe vá bem?
pt.B: Noemi, a sua sogra, lhe disse: "Minha filha, não está na hora de eu procurar para você um lar onde você tenha descanso e onde a sua vida vá bem?
pt.R: Um dia Noemi disse a Rute: "Minha filha, eu quero encontrar um marido e um lar para você, onde você esteja segura e seja bem cuidada.

am.L: አማቷ ኑኃሚንም አለቻት፦ «ልጄ ሆይ፣ መልካም እንዲሆንልሽ የማረፊያ ስፍራ አልፈልግልሽምን?
am.B: አማቷ ኑኃሚን እንዲህ አለቻት፦ «ልጄ፣ ኑሮሽ የሚሳካበት የተረጋጋ ቤት የምፈልግልሽ ጊዜው አሁን አይደለምን?
am.R: አንድ ቀን ኑኃሚን ሩትን እንዲህ አለቻት፦ «ልጄ፣ ደኅንነትሽ ተጠብቆ የምትኖሪበት ባልና ቤት ልፈልግልሽ እፈልጋለሁ።

hi.L: और उसकी सास नाओमी ने उससे कहा, "मेरी बेटी, क्या मैं तुम्हारे लिए विश्राम का स्थान न ढूँढ़ूँ, कि तुम्हारा भला हो?
hi.B: उसकी सास नाओमी ने उससे कहा, "मेरी बेटी, क्या अब समय नहीं कि मैं तुम्हारे लिए एक बसा हुआ घर ढूँढ़ूँ, जहाँ तुम्हारा जीवन सुखी रहे?
hi.R: एक दिन नाओमी ने रूत से कहा, "मेरी बेटी, मैं तुम्हारे लिए एक पति और घर ढूँढ़ना चाहती हूँ, जहाँ तुम सुरक्षित रहो और तुम्हारी देखभाल हो।

ru.L: И сказала ей Ноеминь, свекровь её: «Дочь моя, не поискать ли мне для тебя места покоя, чтобы тебе было хорошо?
ru.B: Ноеминь, её свекровь, сказала ей: «Дочь моя, не пора ли мне найти для тебя надёжный дом, где тебе будет хорошо?
ru.R: Однажды Ноеминь сказала Руфи: «Дочь моя, я хочу найти для тебя мужа и дом, где ты будешь в безопасности и о тебе будут заботиться.

uk.L: І сказала їй Ноомі, її свекруха: «Доню моя, чи не пошукати мені для тебе місця спочинку, щоб тобі було добре?
uk.B: Ноомі, її свекруха, сказала їй: «Доню моя, чи не час мені пошукати для тебе надійного дому, де тобі буде добре?
uk.R: Одного дня Ноомі сказала Рут: «Доню моя, я хочу знайти тобі чоловіка і дім, де ти будеш у безпеці і під опікою.

ja.L: そしてしゅうとめナオミは彼女に言った。「わたしの娘よ、あなたが幸せになるように、わたしはあなたのために安らぎの場所を探すべきではないか？
ja.B: しゅうとめのナオミはルツに言った。「娘よ、あなたが幸せに暮らせるように、落ち着ける家を探してあげる時ではないか？
ja.R: ある日、ナオミはルツに言いました。「娘よ、わたしはあなたに、夫と家を見つけてあげたいの。そこでなら、あなたは安心して、大切にされて暮らせるでしょう。

decisions.choice: a resting place: a settled home in marriage
decisions.reason: The word means a place of rest, a secure home. Naomi has already prayed that each of her daughters-in-law would find rest "in the house of her husband" (1:9), with a word from the same root. Now she sets out to bring that about for Ruth.

decisions.choice: should I not seek: a question that expects yes
decisions.reason: The question is a way of saying "I must". Naomi speaks as the older woman responsible for her widowed daughter-in-law; in that world a marriage was arranged by the family, not by the bride alone.

decisions.choice: a husband and a home ... safe and cared for
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the resting place is (decision m1) and turns the question that expects yes into a statement of what Naomi wants. "Ruth" is named for "her".

decisions.choice: um lugar de descanso (L); um lar onde você tenha descanso (B)
decisions.reason: "Descanso" takes up the word of Naomi's wish in 1:9 (m1), so the reader sees that she now sets out to bring it about; Balanced adds "lar", the settled home that rest means here. Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "विश्राम का स्थान" (a resting place)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word "rest" of 1:9 ("विश्राम"), so the reader sees that Naomi now seeks for Ruth what she wished for both young women there; Balanced and Readable say what it means, a settled home in marriage (m1).

decisions.choice: "место покоя"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "покой", the word of Naomi's wish in 1:9 ("найти покой"), so the echo can be seen; Balanced and Readable say what it is, a settled home in marriage.

decisions.choice: manoach "安らぎの場所" (L), "落ち着ける家" (B), "夫と家" (R), echoing "安らぎ" in 1:9
decisions.reason: The same idea as Naomi's wish in 1:9, a settled home in marriage.

records.literal_gloss: And now, [is] not Boaz our relative, with whose young women you were? Look, he [is] winnowing the threshing floor of the barley tonight.

en.L: And now, is not Boaz our relative, whose young women you were with? Look, he is winnowing [at] the threshing floor of the barley tonight.
en.B: Now Boaz, whose young women you have been working with, is our relative, is he not? Tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
en.R: You know that Boaz is one of our relatives, and you have been working with his young women. Tonight he will be at the threshing floor, winnowing barley. He will toss the grain into the air so the wind can blow the husks away.

sw.L: Na sasa, je, Boazi si jamaa yetu, ambaye ulikuwa pamoja na wasichana wake? Tazama, yeye anapepeta shayiri uwanjani pa kupuria usiku huu.
sw.B: Sasa Boazi, ambaye umekuwa ukifanya kazi pamoja na wasichana wake, ni jamaa yetu, sivyo? Usiku huu anapepeta shayiri katika uwanja wa kupuria.
sw.R: Unajua kwamba Boazi ni mmoja wa jamaa zetu, nawe umekuwa ukifanya kazi pamoja na wasichana wake. Usiku huu atakuwa katika uwanja wa kupuria, akipepeta shayiri. Atairusha nafaka juu hewani ili upepo upeperushe makapi.

es.L: Y ahora, ¿no es Booz nuestro pariente, con cuyas criadas estuviste? He aquí, él avienta esta noche la cebada en la era.
es.B: Ahora bien, Booz, con cuyas criadas has estado trabajando, es pariente nuestro, ¿no es así? Esta noche va a aventar la cebada en la era.
es.R: Tú sabes que Booz es uno de nuestros parientes, y has estado trabajando con sus muchachas. Esta noche él estará en la era aventando la cebada. Lanzará el grano al aire para que el viento se lleve la paja.

fr.L: Et maintenant, Booz, avec les servantes de qui tu as été, n’est-il pas notre parent ? Voici, il vanne l’aire des orges cette nuit.
fr.B: Booz, avec les servantes de qui tu as travaillé, est notre parent, n’est-ce pas ? Ce soir, il vanne l’orge sur l’aire.
fr.R: Tu sais que Booz fait partie de notre famille, et tu as travaillé avec ses servantes. Ce soir, il sera sur l’aire pour vanner l’orge. Il lancera le grain en l’air pour que le vent emporte la paille.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, Bô-ô, người mà con đã ở với các thiếu nữ của ông ấy, chẳng phải là bà con của chúng ta sao? Kìa, đêm nay ông ấy sảy lúa mạch tại sân đập lúa.
vi.B: Bô-ô, người có các thiếu nữ mà con đã làm việc cùng, là bà con của chúng ta, phải không? Đêm nay ông ấy sẽ sảy lúa mạch ở sân đập lúa.
vi.R: Con biết đó, Bô-ô là một người bà con của chúng ta, và con đã làm việc với các thiếu nữ của ông ấy. Đêm nay ông ấy sẽ ở sân đập lúa để sảy lúa mạch. Ông ấy sẽ tung lúa lên cao cho gió thổi bay trấu đi.

ko.L: 이제 네가 함께 있던 젊은 여자들의 주인 보아스가 우리 친척이 아니냐? 보아라, 그가 오늘 밤 타작마당에서 보리를 까부를 것이다.
ko.B: 네가 그 집 여종들과 함께 일했던 보아스는 우리 친척이 아니냐? 그가 오늘 밤 타작마당에서 보리를 까부를 것이다.
ko.R: 너도 알다시피 보아스는 우리 친척이고, 너는 그 집 젊은 여자들과 함께 일했다. 오늘 밤 그는 타작마당에서 보리를 까부를 것이다. 곡식을 공중에 던져 올려서 바람에 겨가 날아가게 하는 것이다.

pt.L: E agora, Boaz, com cujas moças você esteve, não [é] nosso parente? Eis que ele está joeirando [na] eira da cevada esta noite.
pt.B: Ora, Boaz, com cujas moças você tem trabalhado, não é nosso parente? Esta noite ele vai abanar a cevada na eira.
pt.R: Você sabe que Boaz é nosso parente, e você tem trabalhado com as moças dele. Esta noite ele vai estar na eira, abanando a cevada. Ele vai jogar os grãos para o alto para o vento levar embora a palha.

am.L: አሁንም ከልጃገረዶቹ ጋር የነበርሽው ቦዔዝ ዘመዳችን አይደለምን? እነሆ፣ እርሱ ዛሬ ሌሊት በአውድማው ገብስ ያበራያል።
am.B: ከልጃገረዶቹ ጋር ስትሠሪ የነበርሽው ቦዔዝ ዘመዳችን አይደለም እንዴ? ዛሬ ማታ በአውድማው ላይ ገብስ ያበራያል።
am.R: ቦዔዝ ከዘመዶቻችን አንዱ መሆኑን ታውቂያለሽ፤ አንቺም ከልጃገረዶቹ ጋር ስትሠሪ ቆይተሻል። ዛሬ ማታ ገብስ ለማበራየት በአውድማው ላይ ይሆናል። ነፋሱ ገለባውን እንዲወስድለት እህሉን ወደ ላይ ይበትናል።

hi.L: और अब, क्या बोअज़ हमारा कुटुंबी नहीं, जिसकी युवतियों के साथ तुम थीं? देखो, वह आज रात जौ के खलिहान में ओसा रहा है।
hi.B: बोअज़, जिसकी युवतियों के साथ तुम काम करती रही हो, हमारा कुटुंबी है न? आज रात वह खलिहान में जौ ओसा रहा है।
hi.R: तुम तो जानती हो कि बोअज़ हमारा रिश्तेदार है, और तुम उसकी युवतियों के साथ काम करती रही हो। आज रात वह खलिहान में जौ ओसाएगा। वह अनाज को हवा में उछालेगा, ताकि हवा भूसी को उड़ा ले जाए।

ru.L: И теперь, разве не Вооз наш родственник, с чьими девушками ты была? Вот, он веет на гумне ячмень этой ночью.
ru.B: Ведь Вооз, с работницами которого ты была, — наш родственник, не так ли? Сегодня вечером он будет веять ячмень на гумне.
ru.R: Ты знаешь, что Вооз — один из наших родственников, и ты работала с женщинами, которые у него работают. Сегодня вечером он будет на гумне веять ячмень. Он будет подбрасывать зерно, чтобы ветер уносил мякину.

uk.L: А тепер, хіба Вооз не наш родич, з чиїми молодицями ти була? Ось він віє [на] току ячмінь цієї ночі.
uk.B: Ось Вооз, з чиїми молодицями ти працювала, — наш родич, хіба ж ні? Сьогодні ввечері він віятиме ячмінь на току.
uk.R: Ти ж знаєш, що Вооз — один із наших родичів, і ти працювала з його дівчатами. Сьогодні ввечері він буде на току віяти ячмінь. Він підкидатиме зерно в повітря, щоб вітер відносив полову.

ja.L: さて今、あなたがその若い女たちと一緒にいたボアズは、わたしたちの親類ではないか？見なさい、彼は今夜、打ち場で大麦をふるい分けている。
ja.B: ところで、あなたが一緒に働いてきた娘たちの主人ボアズは、わたしたちの親類ではないか？今夜あの人は、打ち場で大麦をふるい分けることになっている。
ja.R: ボアズは、わたしたちの親類の一人よ。あなたは、あの人のところの娘たちと一緒に働いてきたでしょう。今夜、ボアズは打ち場で、大麦をふるい分ける仕事をするの。麦を空中に投げ上げて、風でもみ殻を吹き飛ばすのよ。

decisions.choice: our relative: a member of the family circle
decisions.reason: The word names a relative or close acquaintance. Naomi has already told Ruth that Boaz is one of their redeemers (2:20; see also 2:1). Saying "our" relative, she includes Ruth in the family.

decisions.choice: winnowing at night: separating grain from chaff in the evening breeze
decisions.reason: After threshing, the grain and chaff were thrown into the air with a fork so the wind carried off the light chaff while the heavy grain fell back. The evening breeze was used for the work. The threshing floor was a hard, open place outside the town (verse 15 says Boaz then went into the town), and the owner and workers often slept there to guard the grain.

decisions.choice: He will toss the grain into the air so the wind can blow the husks away.
decisions.reason: Readable explains what winnowing is, since many readers will not know the word. It turns Naomi's question that expects yes into a statement.

decisions.choice: "uwanja wa kupuria" for the threshing floor; "kupepeta" for winnowing
decisions.reason: As agreed for these books in every language: "uwanja wa kupuria" is the open, hard floor where grain is beaten out, and "kupepeta" the everyday Swahili word for tossing grain so that the chaff blows away.

decisions.choice: "la era"; "aventar"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets: the threshing floor is "la era", the flat open place where grain was threshed and winnowed, and "aventar" is the Spanish word for tossing the grain into the wind (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'aire"; "vanner"
alternatives: "le lieu où l'on bat le grain" at Readable
decisions.reason: As the terms note for these books sets, the threshing floor is "l'aire" at every level; it is the place of chapters 3 and 4. Readable explains winnowing, as the English Readable does, so the word "aire" can stay.

decisions.choice: "sân đập lúa" for the threshing floor; "sảy lúa" for winnowing
decisions.reason: As the Joshua–Ruth terms note; "sảy" is the Vietnamese word for separating grain from chaff, which Readable also describes.

decisions.choice: "타작마당" (threshing floor)
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set.

decisions.choice: joeirar (L); abanar (B, R); a eira (every level)
decisions.reason: "Joeirar" is the exact Portuguese word for winnowing (m2) but is little known, so Literal alone keeps it; Balanced says "abanar", the everyday farm word, and Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. decisions.choice: winnow "ማበራየት"; threshing floor "አውድማ"
decisions.reason: "ማበራየት" is the Amharic word for tossing threshed grain into the wind so the chaff blows away, done on the "አውድማ" as in the Pentateuch and the terms list. "ማበጠር" is sifting with a sieve, a different task.

decisions.choice: "खलिहान" (threshing floor); "ओसाना" (winnow)
decisions.reason: The everyday Hindi words for the place where grain is threshed and for tossing it in the wind; Readable explains winnowing as the English does. "खलिहान" through Ruth 3.

records.literal_gloss: And you will wash and anoint yourself and put your garments on you, and go down [to] the threshing floor; do not make yourself known to the man until he finishes eating and drinking.

en.L: So wash and anoint yourself, and put your garments on, and go down to the threshing floor; do not let yourself be known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
en.B: So bathe, put on perfumed oil, dress yourself well, and go down to the threshing floor. But keep out of the man's sight until his eating and drinking are over.
en.R: Take a bath, put on perfume, and dress in your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but stay where he cannot see you until he has finished eating and drinking.

sw.L: Basi uoge, ujipake mafuta, uvae mavazi yako, ushuke uwanjani pa kupuria; usijijulishe kwa mtu huyo mpaka atakapomaliza kula na kunywa.
sw.B: Basi oga, jipake mafuta yenye manukato, vaa vizuri, ushuke uwanjani pa kupuria. Lakini usionekane na mtu huyo mpaka atakapomaliza kula na kunywa.
sw.R: Oga, jipake manukato, uvae nguo zako nzuri kuliko zote. Kisha ushuke uwanjani pa kupuria, lakini kaa mahali asipoweza kukuona mpaka amalize kula na kunywa.

decisions.choice: your garments ... you will go down: the readings of the margin (qere)
alternatives: and I will go down (the written text, read as Naomi's words about herself)
decisions.reason: Two words in this verse are written one way and read another. The written text (ketiv) has "your garment", one garment, perhaps an outer cloak; the margin (qere) reads "your garments". The written text also has a form that looks like "and I will go down"; the margin reads "and you will go down". The written form is most likely an older spelling of the "you" form for a woman, which the margin brings up to date, since Ruth goes down alone (verse 6) and Naomi stays at home (verse 16). The margin is followed in both places.

decisions.choice: wash, anoint, put on garments: making ready, perhaps putting off mourning
decisions.reason: Washing, rubbing the skin with scented oil and putting on clothes are the steps David takes when his time of mourning ends (2 Samuel 12:20), and those a bride's adornment is described with (Ezekiel 16:9-10). Ruth, a widow, is to make herself ready to present herself as a woman free to marry.

decisions.choice: do not make yourself known: keep out of sight until he has eaten
decisions.reason: Ruth is to wait until Boaz has had his meal and lies down (verse 4). She is not to be seen by the man while the workers are about, and the request comes when he is alone and at ease (verse 7).

decisions.choice: dress yourself well / dress in your best clothes
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "put your garments on you", kept at Literal. Coming after the washing and the oil, it means dressing with care (decision m2), which Balanced and Readable say.

records.literal_gloss: And let it be when he lies down, and you will know the place where he lies there, and you will go in and uncover his feet and lie down; and he will tell you what you will do.

en.L: And when he lies down, take note of the place where he lies; then go in and uncover his feet and lie down, and he will tell you what you are to do."
en.B: When he lies down, mark the spot where he is lying. Then go to him, uncover his feet and lie down there, and he will tell you what you should do."
en.R: Watch to see where he lies down to sleep. Then go to him, uncover his feet by turning back his cloak, and lie down there. He will let you know what to do next."

sw.L: Naye atakapolala, uangalie mahali anapolala; kisha uingie, ufunue miguu yake, ulale; naye atakuambia utakalofanya."

es.B: Cuando se acueste, fíjate bien en el lugar donde está acostado. Luego acércate, descúbrele los pies y acuéstate allí, y él te dirá lo que debes hacer».
es.R: Fíjate dónde se acuesta a dormir. Luego acércate, descúbrele los pies apartando su manto y acuéstate allí. Él te dirá lo que tienes que hacer después».

fr.L: Et quand il se couchera, remarque le lieu où il se couche ; puis entre, découvre ses pieds et couche-toi, et il te dira ce que tu dois faire. »
fr.B: Quand il se couchera, repère l’endroit où il est couché. Puis va vers lui, découvre ses pieds et couche-toi là. Il te dira ce que tu dois faire. »

vi.L: Khi ông nằm xuống, con hãy để ý chỗ ông nằm; rồi hãy đến, giở chỗ chân ông ra và nằm xuống, rồi ông sẽ cho con biết điều con phải làm."

ko.L: 그가 누우면 그가 눕는 곳을 잘 보아 두었다가, 들어가서 그의 발치를 들추고 누워라. 그러면 네가 해야 할 일을 그가 너에게 말해 줄 것이다."

ko.R: 그가 어디에 누워 자는지 잘 보아 두어라. 그런 다음 그에게 가서 그의 겉옷을 젖혀 발을 드러내고 거기에 누워라. 그러면 다음에 무엇을 해야 할지 그가 알려 줄 것이다."

pt.R: Observe onde ele vai se deitar para dormir. Depois vá até ele, descubra os pés dele, dobrando para trás a capa dele, e deite-se ali. Ele vai dizer a você o que fazer depois."

am.L: በተኛም ጊዜ የሚተኛበትን ስፍራ ልብ በዪ፤ ገብተሽም እግሩን ግለጪ፤ ተኚም፤ እርሱም የምታደርጊውን ይነግርሻል።»

ja.B: あの人が横になったら、その場所をよく覚えておきなさい。それからそばに行き、足もとをまくって、そこに横になりなさい。そうすれば、あなたがどうすればよいかを、あの人が教えてくれるだろう。」
ja.R: あの人がどこで横になって寝るか、よく見ておきなさい。それからそばに行って、あの人の上着をめくって足もとを出し、そこに横になりなさい。次にどうすればよいかは、あの人が教えてくれるから。」

decisions.choice: uncover his feet: turn back the covering from the place of his feet
alternatives: uncover the place of his legs
a veiled way of saying she is to offer herself to him
decisions.reason: The word for "feet" here is not the common one; it means the place of the feet, the area at a sleeper's feet and legs (the same word comes in Daniel 10:6 for the legs). Ruth is to fold back Boaz's cloak there and lie down at his feet, the place of a servant. It is a silent request that he will understand when he wakes. "Feet" can be a modest way of naming the private parts elsewhere (Isaiah 7:20), and the words "lie down", "know" and "uncover" can all carry a sexual sense, so the scene is told with tension. But the story shows nothing improper happening: Boaz praises Ruth as a woman of worth (verse 11), keeps her safe till morning, and protects her name (verse 14).

decisions.choice: and lie down: the reading of the margin (qere)
alternatives: and I will lie down (the written text)
decisions.reason: As with "go down" in verse 3, the written text has a form that looks like "and I will lie down"; the margin reads "and you will lie down". The written form is most likely the older spelling of the "you" form for a woman, and the margin is followed.

decisions.choice: he will tell you what you are to do: Boaz is to answer
decisions.reason: Naomi leaves the next step to Boaz. In the event Ruth speaks first and tells him what she asks (verse 9), and he answers (verses 10-13).

decisions.choice: by turning back his cloak
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of uncovering his feet and says what the act was (decision m1), so that the reader does not imagine something else.

decisions.choice: "उसकी चादर पैरों की ओर से हटाकर"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, Readable keeps the picture of uncovering his feet and says what the act was (m1): turning back his covering at the place of his feet.

decisions.choice: "uncover his feet" "足もとをあらわにし" (L), "足もとをまくって" (B), "上着をめくって足もとを出し" (R), the same at 3:7
decisions.reason: Literal stays close to the Hebrew; Readable supplies the cloak as the English Readable does.

en.L: And she said to her, "All that you say to me I will do."
en.B: Ruth answered her, "I will do everything you tell me."
en.R: Ruth said, "I will do everything you say."

es.L: Y ella le dijo: «Todo lo que me dices haré».
es.B: Rut le respondió: «Haré todo lo que me digas».
es.R: Rut le dijo: «Haré todo lo que me dices».

fr.L: Et elle lui dit : « Tout ce que tu me dis, je le ferai. »
fr.B: Ruth lui répondit : « Je ferai tout ce que tu me dis. »
fr.R: Ruth a dit : « Je ferai tout ce que tu dis. »

vi.L: Nàng nói với bà: "Mọi điều mẹ bảo con, con sẽ làm."
vi.B: Ru-tơ đáp: "Con sẽ làm mọi điều mẹ bảo."
vi.R: Ru-tơ nói: "Con sẽ làm mọi điều mẹ nói."

ko.L: 룻이 시어머니에게 말했다. "어머님이 저에게 말씀하신 대로 다 하겠어요."
ko.B: 룻이 대답했다. "어머님이 말씀하신 대로 다 하겠어요."

pt.L: E ela lhe disse: "Tudo o que você me disser, eu farei."
pt.B: Rute lhe respondeu: "Farei tudo o que você me disser."
pt.R: Rute disse: "Vou fazer tudo o que você disser."

hi.L: और उसने उससे कहा, "जो कुछ तुम मुझसे कहती हो, वह सब मैं करूँगी।"
hi.B: रूत ने उसे उत्तर दिया, "जो कुछ तुम मुझसे कहोगी, मैं वह सब करूँगी।"
hi.R: रूत ने कहा, "तुम जो कुछ कहोगी, मैं वही करूँगी।"

ru.L: И сказала она ей: «Всё, что ты скажешь мне, сделаю.»
ru.B: Руфь ответила ей: «Я сделаю всё, что ты мне скажешь.»
ru.R: Руфь сказала: «Я сделаю всё, что ты говоришь.»

uk.L: І сказала вона їй: «Усе, що ти кажеш мені, я зроблю.»
uk.B: Рут відповіла їй: «Я зроблю все, що ти мені скажеш.»
uk.R: Рут сказала: «Я зроблю все, що ти кажеш.»

ja.L: そして彼女はしゅうとめに言った。「あなたがわたしに言うことは、すべていたします。」
ja.B: ルツはしゅうとめに答えた。「言われるとおりに、何でもいたします。」
ja.R: ルツは言いました。「お母さんの言うとおりに、全部します。」

decisions.choice: to me: read in the margin (qere) though not written
decisions.reason: The words "to me" are not written in the text; the margin tells the reader to say them. They make no difference to the meaning. The same happens in verse 17.

decisions.choice: all that you say I will do
decisions.reason: Ruth's answer is matched by Boaz's words to her in verse 11, "all that you say I will do for you". She trusts Naomi; Boaz will keep faith with Ruth.

decisions.choice: Ruth
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker, since "she" and "her" are both women.

en.B: So she went down to the threshing floor and did exactly as her mother-in-law had instructed her.
en.R: So Ruth went down to the threshing floor and did just what her mother-in-law had told her.

sw.L: Basi akashuka uwanjani pa kupuria, akafanya sawasawa na yote aliyomwagiza mama mkwe wake.
sw.B: Basi alishuka uwanjani pa kupuria, akafanya sawasawa na alivyoagizwa na mama mkwe wake.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Ruthu alishuka uwanjani pa kupuria, akafanya kama mama mkwe wake alivyomwambia.

es.L: Y bajó a la era e hizo conforme a todo lo que su suegra le había mandado.
es.B: Así que bajó a la era e hizo exactamente lo que su suegra le había indicado.
es.R: Así que Rut bajó a la era e hizo tal como su suegra le había dicho.

fr.L: Et elle descendit à l’aire et fit selon tout ce que sa belle-mère lui avait ordonné.
fr.B: Elle descendit donc à l’aire et fit exactement ce que sa belle-mère lui avait recommandé.
fr.R: Ruth est donc descendue à l’aire, et elle a fait exactement ce que sa belle-mère lui avait dit.

vi.L: Vậy nàng đi xuống sân đập lúa và làm đúng mọi điều mẹ chồng đã dặn bảo nàng.
vi.B: Vậy nàng đi xuống sân đập lúa và làm đúng như mẹ chồng đã dặn.
vi.R: Vậy Ru-tơ đi xuống sân đập lúa và làm đúng như mẹ chồng đã bảo.

ko.L: 룻이 타작마당으로 내려가서 시어머니가 자기에게 명령한 대로 다 하였다.
ko.B: 그래서 룻은 타작마당으로 내려가서 시어머니가 일러 준 대로 그대로 했다.
ko.R: 그래서 룻은 타작마당으로 내려가서 시어머니가 말한 대로 했다.

pt.L: E ela desceu à eira e fez conforme tudo o que a sua sogra lhe tinha ordenado.
pt.B: Então ela desceu à eira e fez exatamente o que a sua sogra lhe tinha recomendado.
pt.R: Então Rute desceu até a eira e fez tudo o que a sogra lhe tinha mandado.

am.L: ወደ አውድማውም ወረደች፤ አማቷም እንዳዘዘቻት ሁሉ አደረገች።
am.B: ስለዚህ ወደ አውድማው ወረደች፤ አማቷ የነገረቻትንም ልክ እንዳለ አደረገች።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሩት ወደ አውድማው ወረደች፤ አማቷ እንደ ነገረቻትም አደረገች።

hi.L: और वह खलिहान को उतर गई और जो कुछ उसकी सास ने उसे आज्ञा दी थी, उस सब के अनुसार किया।
hi.B: तो वह खलिहान को उतर गई और ठीक वैसा ही किया जैसा उसकी सास ने उसे समझाया था।
hi.R: तो रूत खलिहान को गई और ठीक वही किया जो उसकी सास ने उससे कहा था।

ru.L: И спустилась она на гумно и сделала всё, как приказала ей свекровь её.
ru.B: Так она спустилась на гумно и сделала в точности так, как велела ей свекровь.
ru.R: Руфь спустилась на гумно и сделала всё так, как сказала ей свекровь.

uk.L: І зійшла вона на тік, і зробила все, що наказала їй її свекруха.
uk.B: Тож вона зійшла на тік і зробила саме так, як навчила її свекруха.
uk.R: Тож Рут пішла на тік і зробила все так, як їй сказала свекруха.

ja.L: そして彼女は打ち場に下って行き、しゅうとめが彼女に命じたことすべてのとおりにした。
ja.B: こうしてルツは打ち場に下って行き、しゅうとめに言われたとおりにした。
ja.R: ルツは打ち場に下って行って、しゅうとめに言われたとおりにしました。

decisions.choice: did according to all: a summary told first
decisions.reason: The verse sums up what follows: verse 7 tells how she carried out each step. In fact she goes one step further than Naomi said, by speaking first (verse 9).

records.literal_gloss: And ate Boaz and drank, and was good his heart, and he went to lie down at [the] end of the heap; and she came in secret and uncovered his feet and lay down.

en.L: And Boaz ate and drank, and his heart was good, and he went to lie down at the end of the grain heap. Then she came quietly and uncovered his feet and lay down.
en.B: Boaz ate and drank and was in a happy mood. He went off and lay down at the far end of the grain pile, and she came quietly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.
en.R: Boaz ate and drank, and he felt happy and content. Then he went to sleep at the far end of the pile of grain. Ruth came quietly, uncovered his feet by turning back his cloak, and lay down there.

sw.L: Naye Boazi akala, akanywa, na moyo wake ukawa mwema, akaenda kulala mwisho wa lile rundo la nafaka. Naye akaja kimya kimya, akafunua miguu yake, akalala.
sw.B: Boazi alikula na kunywa, akachangamka. Alikwenda kulala upande wa mwisho wa rundo la nafaka, naye Ruthu akaja kimya kimya, akafunua miguu yake, akalala.
sw.R: Boazi alikula na kunywa, akajisikia mwenye furaha na kuridhika. Kisha alikwenda kulala upande wa mwisho wa rundo la nafaka. Ruthu alikuja kimya kimya, akafunua miguu yake kwa kulirudisha nyuma vazi lake, akalala hapo.

es.L: Y Booz comió y bebió, y su corazón estuvo alegre, y fue a acostarse al extremo del montón de grano. Y ella vino calladamente y descubrió sus pies y se acostó.
es.B: Booz comió y bebió y estaba de buen ánimo. Se fue a acostar al otro extremo del montón de grano, y ella llegó sin hacer ruido, le descubrió los pies y se acostó.
es.R: Booz comió y bebió, y se sentía feliz y contento. Después se fue a dormir al otro extremo del montón de grano. Rut llegó sin hacer ruido, le descubrió los pies apartando su manto y se acostó allí.

fr.L: Et Booz mangea et but, et son cœur fut content, et il alla se coucher au bout du tas [de grain]. Et elle vint doucement, découvrit ses pieds et se coucha.
fr.B: Booz mangea et but, et il était de bonne humeur. Il alla se coucher à l’autre bout du tas de grain, et elle vint sans bruit, découvrit ses pieds et se coucha.
fr.R: Booz a mangé et bu, et il était content et heureux. Ensuite, il est allé dormir à l’autre bout du tas de grain. Ruth est arrivée sans bruit, elle a découvert ses pieds en soulevant le bord de sa couverture, et elle s’est couchée là.

vi.L: Bô-ô ăn uống, lòng ông vui vẻ, và ông đi nằm ở cuối đống lúa. Rồi nàng đến lặng lẽ, giở chỗ chân ông ra và nằm xuống.
vi.B: Bô-ô ăn uống xong thì lòng thấy vui vẻ. Ông đến nằm ở đầu kia đống lúa. Nàng đến lặng lẽ, giở chăn nơi chân ông ra và nằm xuống.
vi.R: Bô-ô ăn uống xong, lòng thấy vui vẻ và mãn nguyện. Rồi ông đi ngủ ở đầu kia đống lúa. Ru-tơ đến lặng lẽ, lật tấm áo choàng nơi chân ông lên, và nằm xuống đó.

ko.L: 보아스가 먹고 마시고 마음이 즐거워져서, 곡식 더미 끝에 가서 누웠다. 그러자 룻이 살그머니 가서 그의 발치를 들추고 누웠다.
ko.B: 보아스는 먹고 마시고 기분이 좋아져서, 곡식 더미 끝으로 가서 누웠다. 그러자 룻이 살그머니 가서 그의 발치 이불을 들추고 누웠다.
ko.R: 보아스는 먹고 마시고 나서 기분이 좋았다. 그는 곡식 더미 끝으로 가서 잠자리에 들었다. 룻이 살그머니 다가가서 그의 겉옷을 젖혀 발을 드러내고 거기에 누웠다.

pt.L: E Boaz comeu e bebeu, e o seu coração ficou alegre, e ele foi se deitar na ponta do monte de grãos. Então ela veio às escondidas, e descobriu os pés dele, e se deitou.
pt.B: Boaz comeu e bebeu e ficou de bom humor. Ele foi se deitar na outra ponta do monte de grãos, e ela chegou sem fazer barulho, descobriu os pés dele e se deitou.
pt.R: Boaz comeu e bebeu e ficou alegre e satisfeito. Depois ele foi dormir na outra ponta do monte de grãos. Rute chegou de mansinho, descobriu os pés dele, dobrando para trás a capa dele, e se deitou ali.

am.L: ቦዔዝም በላ፤ ጠጣም፤ ልቡም ደስ አለው፤ በእህሉም ክምር ዳር ሊተኛ ሄደ። እርሷም በስውር መጥታ እግሩን ገለጠች፤ ተኛችም።
am.B: ቦዔዝ በልቶ ጠጥቶ ደስ አለው። ከዚያም ሄዶ በእህሉ ክምር ጫፍ ላይ ተኛ፤ እርሷም በቀስታ መጥታ እግሩን ገለጠችና ተኛች።
am.R: ቦዔዝ በላ፤ ጠጣም፤ ደስ ብሎትም ረካ። ከዚያም ሄዶ በእህሉ ክምር ጫፍ ላይ ተኛ። ሩትም በቀስታ መጥታ ልብሱን ወደ ኋላ በመግለጥ እግሩን ገለጠች፤ በዚያም ተኛች።

hi.L: और बोअज़ ने खाया और पिया, और उसका मन अच्छा था, और वह अनाज के ढेर के छोर पर लेटने गया। तब वह चुपके से आई और उसके पैर उघाड़कर लेट गई।
hi.B: बोअज़ ने खाया-पिया और उसका मन प्रसन्न हो गया। वह जाकर अनाज के ढेर के उस पार के छोर पर लेट गया। तब रूत चुपके से आई, उसके पैर उघाड़े और लेट गई।
hi.R: बोअज़ ने खाया-पिया, और वह ख़ुश और संतुष्ट था। फिर वह अनाज के ढेर के दूसरे छोर पर सोने चला गया। रूत चुपके से आई, उसकी चादर पैरों की ओर से हटाकर उसके पैर उघाड़े, और वहीं लेट गई।

ru.L: И ел Вооз, и пил, и было хорошо сердцу его, и пошёл он лечь у края кучи [зерна]; а она пришла тихо, и открыла его ноги, и легла.
ru.B: Вооз поел и попил и был в хорошем настроении. Он пошёл и лёг у дальнего края кучи зерна, а она тихо подошла, открыла его ноги и легла.
ru.R: Вооз поел и попил, и ему было хорошо и радостно. Потом он лёг спать у дальнего края кучи зерна. Руфь тихо подошла, отвернула край его плаща с ног и легла там.

uk.L: І їв Вооз, і пив, і було добре його серцю, і пішов він лягти на краю купи [зерна]. А вона прийшла тихо, і відкрила його ноги, і лягла.
uk.B: Вооз поїв і попив, і настрій у нього був веселий. Він пішов і ліг на дальньому краю купи зерна, а вона тихо підійшла, відкрила його ноги і лягла.
uk.R: Вооз поїв і попив, і йому було радісно й спокійно на душі. Потім він ліг спати на дальньому краю купи зерна. Рут тихо підійшла, відгорнула плащ із його ніг і лягла там.

ja.L: そしてボアズは食べて飲み、心が楽しくなって、積み上げた麦の端に行って横になった。そして彼女はそっと来て、彼の足もとをあらわにし、横になった。
ja.B: ボアズは食べたり飲んだりして上機嫌になり、麦の山の端に行って横になった。ルツはそっと近づいて、足もとをまくり、そこに横になった。
ja.R: ボアズは食べたり飲んだりして、楽しく満ち足りた気分になりました。それから、積み上げた麦の山の向こうの端に行って、寝ました。ルツはそっと近づき、ボアズの上着をめくって足もとを出し、そこに横になりました。

decisions.choice: his heart was good: he was cheerful and content
decisions.reason: "His heart was good" means he was in good spirits after the meal (Judges 19:6; 1 Kings 21:7). It does not say he was drunk; the harvest meal ends a good day's work, and Boaz is clear-headed when he wakes (verses 10-13).

decisions.choice: at the end of the grain heap: guarding the harvest
decisions.reason: The owner slept beside the heap of winnowed grain to guard it through the night. The edge of the heap was away from the others, which let Ruth come to him unseen.

decisions.choice: quietly ... uncovered his feet
decisions.reason: The word means secretly or softly, without being noticed (1 Samuel 18:22; 24:5). She does just what Naomi said (verse 4); see the decision there on uncovering his feet.

source.text: וַיְהִי֙ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֔יְלָה וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד הָאִ֖ישׁ וַיִּלָּפֵ֑ת וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִשָּׁ֔ה שֹׁכֶ֖בֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in [the] middle of the night, and trembled the man and turned himself, and there, a woman lying [at] his feet.

en.L: And it happened at midnight that the man was startled and turned himself, and there was a woman lying at his feet!
en.B: In the middle of the night the man woke with a start and turned over. A woman was lying at his feet!
en.R: In the middle of the night Boaz suddenly woke up. He turned over and was surprised to find a woman lying at his feet.

sw.L: Ikawa usiku wa manane mtu huyo akashtuka, akajigeuza, na tazama, mwanamke amelala miguuni pake!
sw.B: Usiku wa manane mtu huyo aliamka kwa mshtuko, akajigeuza. Mwanamke alikuwa amelala miguuni pake!
sw.R: Usiku wa manane Boazi aliamka ghafla. Alijigeuza, akashangaa kumkuta mwanamke amelala miguuni pake.

es.L: Y sucedió a la medianoche que el hombre se sobresaltó y se volvió, ¡y he aquí una mujer acostada a sus pies!
es.B: A medianoche el hombre se despertó sobresaltado y se dio la vuelta. ¡Había una mujer acostada a sus pies!
es.R: A medianoche Booz se despertó de repente. Se dio la vuelta y se sorprendió al encontrar a una mujer acostada a sus pies.

fr.L: Et il arriva au milieu de la nuit que l’homme sursauta et se retourna, et voici, une femme était couchée à ses pieds !
fr.B: Au milieu de la nuit, l’homme se réveilla en sursaut et se retourna : une femme était couchée à ses pieds !
fr.R: Au milieu de la nuit, Booz s’est réveillé tout à coup. Il s’est retourné et il a été surpris de trouver une femme couchée à ses pieds.

vi.L: Vào nửa đêm, người ấy giật mình và trở mình, và kìa, có một người đàn bà nằm nơi chân ông!
vi.B: Nửa đêm, người ấy giật mình thức dậy và trở mình. Có một người đàn bà đang nằm nơi chân ông!
vi.R: Nửa đêm, Bô-ô bỗng thức giấc. Ông trở mình và ngạc nhiên thấy một người đàn bà đang nằm nơi chân mình.

ko.L: 한밤중에 그 사람이 놀라서 몸을 돌이켰는데, 보라, 한 여자가 그의 발치에 누워 있었다!
ko.B: 한밤중에 그 사람이 깜짝 놀라 깨어 몸을 뒤척였다. 한 여자가 그의 발치에 누워 있었다!
ko.R: 한밤중에 보아스가 갑자기 깨어났다. 그는 몸을 돌리다가 한 여자가 자기 발치에 누워 있는 것을 보고 깜짝 놀랐다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, à meia-noite, que o homem se assustou e se virou, e eis que uma mulher estava deitada aos seus pés!
pt.B: No meio da noite, o homem acordou assustado e se virou. Havia uma mulher deitada aos seus pés!
pt.R: No meio da noite, Boaz acordou de repente. Ele se virou e ficou surpreso ao ver uma mulher deitada aos seus pés.

am.L: በእኩለ ሌሊትም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሰውየው ደነገጠ፤ ዘወርም አለ፤ እነሆም፣ አንዲት ሴት በእግሩ አጠገብ ተኝታ ነበር።
am.B: በእኩለ ሌሊት ሰውየው ደንግጦ ነቃና ዞር አለ። አንዲት ሴት በእግሩ አጠገብ ተኝታ ነበር!
am.R: በእኩለ ሌሊት ቦዔዝ ድንገት ነቃ። ዞር ሲል አንዲት ሴት በእግሩ አጠገብ ተኝታ በማየቱ ተገረመ።

hi.L: और आधी रात को ऐसा हुआ कि वह पुरुष चौंक उठा और करवट ली, और देखो, एक स्त्री उसके पैरों के पास लेटी थी!
hi.B: आधी रात को वह पुरुष चौंककर जाग उठा और करवट बदली। एक स्त्री उसके पैरों के पास लेटी थी!
hi.R: आधी रात को बोअज़ अचानक जाग गया। उसने करवट बदली और उसे यह देखकर अचरज हुआ कि एक स्त्री उसके पैरों के पास लेटी है।

ru.L: И было в полночь, и вздрогнул тот человек, и повернулся, и вот — женщина лежит у ног его!
ru.B: Посреди ночи этот человек вздрогнул, проснулся и повернулся на другой бок. У его ног лежала женщина!
ru.R: Посреди ночи Вооз вдруг проснулся. Он повернулся и с удивлением увидел, что у его ног лежит женщина.

uk.L: І сталося опівночі, що здригнувся той чоловік і повернувся, і ось — жінка лежить біля його ніг!
uk.B: Опівночі той чоловік прокинувся, здригнувшись, і повернувся. Біля його ніг лежала жінка!
uk.R: Посеред ночі Вооз раптом прокинувся. Він повернувся і здивувався: біля його ніг лежала жінка.

ja.L: そして真夜中のことであった。その人は驚いて身をよじった。するとなんと、一人の女が彼の足もとに寝ていた。
ja.B: 真夜中に、その人ははっとして目を覚まし、寝返りを打った。すると、足もとに女が一人寝ているではないか。
ja.R: 真夜中に、ボアズは急に目を覚ましました。寝返りを打つと、足もとに女の人が寝ていたので、びっくりしました。

decisions.choice: startled and turned himself: he woke with a start and turned or bent forward
alternatives: he bent forward (to feel what was there)
decisions.reason: The first verb means to tremble or start in fear or surprise. The second means to twist, turn or bend; Judges 16:29 uses it of Samson taking hold of the pillars. Boaz may have shivered with the cold at his uncovered feet, then turned over or leaned forward to see.

decisions.choice: there was a woman: seen through Boaz's eyes
decisions.reason: The word "there" (hinneh) takes the reader into Boaz's surprise. In the dark he sees only that a woman is lying there; he does not yet know who she is (verse 9).

decisions.choice: Boaz
decisions.reason: Readable names "the man" as Boaz, as verse 7 has.

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־אָ֑תּוַתֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ ר֣וּת אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֤ כְנָפֶ֨ךָ֙ עַל־אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ כִּ֥י גֹאֵ֖ל אָֽתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, who [are] you? And she said, I [am] Ruth your maidservant, and you will spread your wing over your maidservant, for a redeemer you [are].

en.L: And he said, "Who are you?" And she said, "I am Ruth, your maidservant. Spread your wing over your maidservant, for you are a redeemer."
en.B: "Who are you?" he asked. She answered, "I am Ruth, your servant. Spread the wing of your cloak over your servant, for you are a family redeemer."
en.R: "Who are you?" he asked. She answered, "I am Ruth, your servant. Cover me with the corner of your cloak to show that you will marry me and take care of me. You are one of our family redeemers."

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Wewe ni nani?" Naye akasema, "Mimi ni Ruthu, mjakazi wako. Utandaze bawa lako juu ya mjakazi wako, kwa maana wewe ni mkombozi."
sw.B: Akauliza, "Wewe ni nani?" Akajibu, "Mimi ni Ruthu, mtumishi wako. Tandaza upindo wa vazi lako juu ya mtumishi wako, kwa maana wewe ni mkombozi wa jamaa."
sw.R: Akauliza, "Wewe ni nani?" Akajibu, "Mimi ni Ruthu, mtumishi wako. Nifunike kwa pembe ya vazi lako kuonyesha kwamba utanioa na kunitunza. Wewe ni mmoja wa wakombozi wa jamaa yetu."

es.L: Y dijo: «¿Quién eres?». Y ella dijo: «Yo soy Rut, tu sierva. Extiende tu ala sobre tu sierva, porque tú eres redentor».
es.B: «¿Quién eres?», le preguntó. Ella respondió: «Soy Rut, tu sierva. Extiende el ala de tu manto sobre tu sierva, porque tú eres pariente redentor».
es.R: «¿Quién eres?», le preguntó. Ella le contestó: «Soy Rut, tu sierva. Cúbreme con el borde de tu manto, para mostrar que te casarás conmigo y me cuidarás. Tú eres uno de nuestros parientes redentores».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Qui es-tu ? » Et elle dit : « Je suis Ruth, ta servante. Étends ton aile sur ta servante, car tu es rédempteur. »
fr.B: « Qui es-tu ? » demanda-t-il. Elle répondit : « Je suis Ruth, ta servante. Étends sur ta servante l’aile de ton manteau, car tu es un proche parent rédempteur. »
fr.R: « Qui es-tu ? » a-t-il demandé. Elle a répondu : « Je suis Ruth, ta servante. Couvre-moi avec le bord de ton manteau, pour montrer que tu vas m’épouser et prendre soin de moi. Tu es l’un de nos proches parents rédempteurs. »

vi.L: Ông hỏi: "Ngươi là ai?" Nàng đáp: "Tôi là Ru-tơ, tớ gái của ông. Xin ông giăng cánh của ông trên tớ gái ông, vì ông là người chuộc lại."
vi.B: Ông hỏi: "Ai đó?" Nàng đáp: "Tôi là Ru-tơ, đầy tớ gái của ông. Xin ông giăng cánh áo của ông che cho đầy tớ gái ông, vì ông là người bà con có quyền chuộc lại."
vi.R: Ông hỏi: "Ai đó?" Nàng trả lời: "Tôi là Ru-tơ, đầy tớ của ông. Xin ông lấy vạt áo choàng của ông che cho tôi, để tỏ rằng ông sẽ cưới tôi và chăm sóc tôi. Ông là một trong những người bà con có quyền chuộc lại của gia đình chúng tôi."

ko.L: 그가 말했다. "너는 누구냐?" 룻이 말했다. "저는 주인님의 여종 룻입니다. 주인님의 날개를 주인님의 여종 위에 펴 주십시오. 주인님은 기업 무를 자이십니다."
ko.B: 그가 물었다. "너는 누구냐?" 룻이 대답했다. "저는 주인님의 여종 룻입니다. 주인님의 옷자락 날개를 이 여종 위에 펴 주십시오. 주인님은 우리 집안을 책임지는 친족이십니다."
ko.R: 보아스가 물었다. "너는 누구냐?" 룻이 대답했다. "저는 주인님의 여종 룻입니다. 주인님의 겉옷 자락으로 저를 덮어 주십시오. 저와 결혼하여 저를 돌보아 주시겠다는 표시로 그렇게 해 주십시오. 주인님은 우리 집안을 책임지는 친족 가운데 한 분이십니다."

pt.L: E ele disse: "Quem é você?" E ela disse: "Eu sou Rute, a sua serva. Estenda a sua asa sobre a sua serva, pois o senhor é resgatador."
pt.B: "Quem é você?", ele perguntou. Ela respondeu: "Eu sou Rute, a sua serva. Estenda sobre a sua serva a aba do seu manto, pois o senhor é um resgatador da nossa família."
pt.R: "Quem é você?", ele perguntou. Ela respondeu: "Eu sou Rute, a sua serva. Cubra-me com a aba da sua capa, para mostrar que o senhor vai se casar comigo e cuidar de mim. O senhor é um dos resgatadores da nossa família."

am.L: እርሱም፦ «አንቺ ማን ነሽ?» አለ። እርሷም፦ «እኔ ገረድዎ ሩት ነኝ። ክንፍዎን በገረድዎ ላይ ይዘርጉ፤ ቤዢ ነዎትና» አለች።
am.B: እርሱም፦ «ማን ነሽ?» ብሎ ጠየቀ። እርሷም፦ «አገልጋይዎ ሩት ነኝ። የልብስዎን ክንፍ በአገልጋይዎ ላይ ይዘርጉ፤ ቤዢ ዘመድ ነዎትና» ብላ መለሰች።
am.R: እርሱም፦ «ማን ነሽ?» ብሎ ጠየቀ። እርሷም፦ «አገልጋይዎ ሩት ነኝ። እንደሚያገቡኝና እንደሚንከባከቡኝ ለማሳየት በልብስዎ ጫፍ ይሸፍኑኝ። እርስዎ ከቤዢ ዘመዶቻችን አንዱ ነዎት» ብላ መለሰች።

hi.L: और उसने कहा, "तुम कौन हो?" और उसने कहा, "मैं आपकी दासी रूत हूँ। अपनी दासी पर अपना पंख फैलाइए, क्योंकि आप छुड़ानेवाले हैं।"
hi.B: "तुम कौन हो?" उसने पूछा। उसने उत्तर दिया, "मैं आपकी दासी रूत हूँ। अपने ओढ़ने का पंख अपनी दासी पर फैला दीजिए, क्योंकि आप परिवार के छुड़ानेवाले हैं।"
hi.R: "तुम कौन हो?" उसने पूछा। रूत ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं आपकी दासी रूत हूँ। अपनी चादर का कोना मुझ पर डाल दीजिए, यह दिखाने के लिए कि आप मुझसे विवाह करेंगे और मेरी देखभाल करेंगे। आप हमारे परिवार के छुड़ानेवालों में से एक हैं।"

ru.L: И сказал он: «Кто ты?» И сказала она: «Я — Руфь, служанка твоя. Простри крыло твоё над служанкой твоей, потому что ты — выкупщик.»
ru.B: «Кто ты?» — спросил он. Она ответила: «Я Руфь, твоя служанка. Простри крыло своего плаща над своей служанкой, ведь ты выкупщик нашей семьи.»
ru.R: «Кто ты?» — спросил он. Она ответила: «Я Руфь, твоя служанка. Укрой меня краем своего плаща в знак того, что ты женишься на мне и будешь заботиться обо мне. Ты один из выкупщиков нашей семьи.»

uk.L: І сказав він: «Хто ти?» А вона сказала: «Я Рут, твоя служниця. Простягни своє крило над своєю служницею, бо ти викупитель.»
uk.B: «Хто ти?» — спитав він. Вона відповіла: «Я Рут, твоя служниця. Простягни над своєю служницею крило свого плаща, бо ти родич-викупитель.»
uk.R: «Хто ти?» — спитав він. Вона відповіла: «Я Рут, твоя служниця. Прикрий мене полою свого плаща на знак того, що ти одружишся зі мною і дбатимеш про мене. Ти один із наших родичів-викупителів.»

ja.L: そして彼は言った。「あなたはだれか？」そして彼女は言った。「わたしはあなたのはしためルツです。あなたの翼をあなたのはしための上に広げてください。あなたは買い戻す者ですから。」
ja.B: 「あなたはだれか？」とボアズが尋ねると、彼女は答えた。「わたしはあなたのはしため、ルツです。あなたの衣の裾を翼のように、このはしための上に広げてください。あなたは買い戻しの責任のある親族ですから。」
ja.R: 「だれだ？」とボアズが聞くと、ルツは答えました。「あなたにお仕えする者、ルツです。あなたの上着の裾で、わたしを覆ってください。わたしと結婚して、わたしの面倒を見てくださるというしるしに。あなたは、わたしたちの家の、買い戻す責任のある親類の一人なのです。」

decisions.choice: spread your wing over: take me as your wife and under your protection
decisions.reason: The word means a wing, and also the corner or edge of a garment. Spreading the corner of one's garment over a woman was a sign of taking her as wife (Ezekiel 16:8, where God says "I spread my wing over you ... and you became mine"; compare Deuteronomy 23:1). Boaz had prayed that Ruth would find a full reward from the LORD, "under whose wings you have come to take refuge" (2:12). Now she asks Boaz himself to be the answer to that prayer.

decisions.choice: your maidservant: a woman who could become a wife
decisions.reason: In 2:13 Ruth called herself by a humbler word for a servant girl, one not even counted among his servants. Here she uses another word for a female servant, one used of women who could be taken as wives (as Hagar and Bilhah, Genesis 21:10; 30:3). She speaks humbly, but as one who may marry him.

decisions.choice: you are a redeemer: the reason for her request
decisions.reason: The redeemer (go'el) was the close relative bound to buy back family land and care for the family line (2:20; Leviticus 25:25). The law gave the duty of marrying a dead man's widow to his brother (Deuteronomy 25:5-10), not to the redeemer. Ruth joins the two duties: she asks Boaz, as redeemer, to marry her and keep her dead husband's family alive. Boaz accepts that this goes together (verses 12-13), and so does the town (4:5, 10).

decisions.choice: the wing of your cloak
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the word "wing", so that the link with 2:12 can be seen, and adds "of your cloak" to show that a garment is meant. Literal keeps "your wing" alone.

decisions.choice: to show that you will marry me and take care of me ... one of our family redeemers
decisions.reason: Readable says what the gesture meant (decision m1) and names the family the redeemer acts for (decision m3). It says "one of our family redeemers", as Naomi did (2:20), because a nearer redeemer exists (verse 12).

decisions.choice: family redeemer
decisions.reason: "Family redeemer" at Balanced and Readable, "redeemer" at Literal, as throughout Ruth (2:20), so that the reader sees a relative's duty is meant, not salvation from sin.

decisions.choice: "bawa" (wing) at Literal, "upindo wa vazi" (the edge of the cloak) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the same as the "wings" of the LORD in 2:12 (m1). Literal keeps "bawa", so that the link with "mabawa" in 2:12 can be seen; Balanced names the cloak, as the English "the wing of your cloak" does, and Readable says what the act means.

decisions.choice: "extiende tu ala" (L); "extiende el ala de tu manto" (B); "cúbreme con el borde de tu manto" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means both a wing and the corner of a garment. Literal and Balanced keep "ala", so that the reader hears Boaz's own blessing in 2:12, "bajo cuyas alas": Ruth asks Boaz to be the shelter he prayed God would give her (m1). Readable says what the gesture means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ton aile" (L); "l'aile de ton manteau" (B); "le bord de ton manteau" (R)
alternatives: "le pan de ton manteau" at Balanced, which loses the link with 2:12
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means both a wing and the corner of a garment (m1). Boaz blessed Ruth for taking refuge under the LORD's "wings" (2:12), and now she asks him to spread his own "wing" over her. Literal and Balanced keep "aile" so the reader can see the link, as the terms note asks; Readable says what the gesture meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "giăng cánh" (L), "giăng cánh áo" (B) for "spread your wing"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "wing" is also the corner of a cloak, and it takes up Boaz's blessing in 2:12, "dưới cánh" (meaning decision). Vietnamese "cánh áo", the flap of a garment, keeps the same word at Balanced; Readable says what the gesture means.

decisions.choice: Boaz, startled in the dark, says "ngươi" at Literal; Balanced and Readable "Ai đó?"
decisions.reason: He does not yet know who is there; a bare "Who are you?" needs a pronoun in Vietnamese, and "ngươi" is the neutral one for an unknown person at Literal. The other levels avoid the pronoun.

decisions.choice: "날개" kept at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the "wing" under which Ruth came to shelter in 2:12, here the corner of Boaz's cloak. Keeping "날개" lets the reader hear the link; Readable says what the gesture asks.

decisions.choice: "기업 무를 자" at Literal; "집안을 책임지는 친족" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for *goel*, and as 2:20.

decisions.choice: Estenda a sua asa (L); Estenda ... a aba do seu manto (B); Cubra-me com a aba da sua capa (R)
alternatives: Estenda a asa do seu manto
decisions.reason: Kanaf is both a wing and the corner of a garment (m1). Literal keeps "asa", so that Ruth's words echo Boaz's prayer that she find refuge under the LORD's "asas" (2:12). Portuguese cannot say "a asa do manto", so Balanced and Readable say "a aba", the flap or edge of a garment, the other sense of the same word, and the meaning note keeps the link; Readable adds what the gesture meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a sua serva; o senhor
decisions.reason: Ruth speaks of herself as "a sua serva" ('amah, a servant who could become a wife, m2) and to Boaz as "o senhor", the address of section 4 for a superior, as in 2:10, 13. 'Amah is "serva" at every level, kept apart from "criada" for shifchah in 2:13 at Literal.

decisions.choice: "ክንፍዎን … ይዘርጉ" (Literal); "የልብስዎን ክንፍ … ይዘርጉ" (Balanced); "በልብስዎ ጫፍ ይሸፍኑኝ" with what it means (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew kanaf is both a wing and the corner of a cloak, and Ruth's words take up Boaz's prayer in 2:12 that she find refuge under the LORD's wings ("ክንፎች" there). Literal and Balanced keep "ክንፍ" so the reader hears the echo; Readable says the cloak's corner and explains the request, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "पंख" (wing) at Literal and Balanced; "अपने ओढ़ने का पंख" (the wing of your covering) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the "wings" of 2:12, under which Ruth has come to take refuge with the LORD. Literal and Balanced keep "पंख" so the link can be heard, and Balanced adds "ओढ़ने का" (of your covering) to show a garment is meant, as the English does; Readable says "चादर का कोना" and what the gesture meant (m1).

decisions.choice: "крыло" (Literal); "крыло своего плаща" (Balanced); "край своего плаща" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "крыло", so that Ruth's request echoes Boaz's blessing in 2:12 ("под чьими крыльями"), and Balanced adds "плаща" to show a garment is meant. "Пола" is the usual Russian word for the flap of a garment but would lose the echo; Readable uses "край" and says what the gesture meant.

decisions.choice: "служанка"
decisions.reason: Ruth calls herself an amah, a servant woman who could become a wife (m2); "служанка", as for the shifchah in 2:13, since "рабыня" would make her a slave and miss the point of her request.

decisions.choice: "крило" (L), "крило свого плаща" (B); "пола плаща" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one for the LORD's "wings" in 2:12; Literal and Balanced keep "крило" so the reader hears Ruth ask Boaz to be the answer to his own blessing. Readable names the corner of the cloak ("пола") and says what the sign means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: kanaph "翼" (L), "衣の裾を翼のように" (B), "上着の裾" (R), so that Boaz's "under whose wings" (2:12) is heard here
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one word for wing and the corner of a garment; Balanced keeps both pictures.

decisions.choice: amah "はしため" (L, B), as Ruth's shifchah in 2:13; Readable "あなたにお仕えする者"
decisions.reason: Japanese has one humble word for a woman speaking of herself; the change of Hebrew word is explained in the meaning decision.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בְּרוּכָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּתִּ֔י הֵיטַ֛בְתְּ חַסְדֵּ֥ךְ הָאַחֲר֖וֹן מִן־הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן לְבִלְתִּי־לֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵי֙ הַבַּ֣חוּרִ֔ים אִם־דַּ֖ל וְאִם־עָשִֽׁיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, blessed [are] you by YHWH, my daughter; you have made good your latter steadfast love more than the first, by not going after the young men, whether poor or rich.

en.L: And he said, "Blessed are you by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, my daughter! You have made this latter steadfast love better than the first, by not going after the young men, whether poor or rich.
en.B: He said, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you, my daughter! This faithful love you have shown now is greater than what you showed before, since you have not looked to the young men for a husband, whether poor or rich.
en.R: Boaz said, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you, my daughter! You showed faithful love to Naomi before, and now you are showing even greater faithful love. You could have tried to marry a younger man, rich or poor, but you did not.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Ubarikiwe na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, binti yangu! Umeifanya fadhili hii ya mwisho kuwa njema kuliko ile ya kwanza, kwa kutowafuata vijana, kama ni maskini au matajiri.
sw.B: Akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akubariki, binti yangu! Fadhili hii unayoonyesha sasa ni kubwa kuliko ile uliyoonyesha mwanzo, kwa kuwa hukuwatafuta vijana kuolewa nao, wawe maskini au matajiri.
sw.R: Boazi alisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akubariki, binti yangu! Hapo mwanzo ulimwonyesha Naomi fadhili, na sasa unaonyesha fadhili kubwa zaidi. Ungeweza kujaribu kuolewa na kijana, tajiri au maskini, lakini hukufanya hivyo.

es.L: Y él dijo: «¡Bendita seas tú {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, hija mía! Has hecho este último amor leal mejor que el primero, al no ir tras los jóvenes, sean pobres o ricos.
es.B: Él le dijo: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te bendiga, hija mía! Este amor fiel que muestras ahora es aún mayor que el que mostraste antes, pues no has buscado marido entre los jóvenes, ni pobres ni ricos.
es.R: Booz le dijo: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te bendiga, hija mía! Antes mostraste amor fiel a Noemí, y ahora estás mostrando un amor fiel todavía mayor. Podrías haber buscado casarte con un hombre más joven, rico o pobre, pero no lo hiciste.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Bénie sois-tu par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ma fille ! Tu as rendu ce dernier amour loyal meilleur que le premier, en n’allant pas après les jeunes gens, pauvres ou riches.
fr.B: Il dit : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bénisse, ma fille ! L’amour fidèle que tu montres maintenant est plus grand encore que celui que tu as montré auparavant, puisque tu n’as pas cherché un mari parmi les jeunes gens, pauvres ou riches.
fr.R: Booz a dit : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bénisse, ma fille ! Avant, tu as montré un amour fidèle à Noémi, et maintenant tu montres un amour fidèle encore plus grand. Tu aurais pu essayer d’épouser un homme plus jeune, riche ou pauvre, mais tu ne l’as pas fait.

vi.L: Ông nói: "Con gái ta, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho con! Con đã tỏ lòng nhân từ sau này còn hơn lúc trước, vì con không đi theo các chàng trai, dù nghèo hay giàu.
vi.B: Ông nói: "Con gái ta, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho con! Lòng nhân từ con tỏ ra lần này còn lớn hơn lần trước, vì con đã không tìm chồng trong các chàng trai trẻ, dù nghèo hay giàu.
vi.R: Bô-ô nói: "Con gái ta, nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho con! Trước đây con đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với Na-ô-mi, và bây giờ con còn tỏ lòng nhân từ lớn hơn nữa. Con có thể tìm cách lấy một người trẻ hơn, giàu hay nghèo, nhưng con đã không làm vậy.

ko.L: 그가 말했다. "내 딸아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 복을 받기를 바란다! 네가 가난하든 부자이든 젊은 남자들을 따라가지 않았으니, 네가 나중에 베푼 한결같은 사랑이 처음 것보다 더 좋구나.
ko.B: 보아스가 말했다. "내 딸아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 복을 주시기를 바란다! 네가 지금 보여 준 한결같은 사랑은 전에 보여 준 것보다 더 크구나. 너는 가난하든 부자이든 젊은 남자를 찾아가 남편으로 삼으려 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 보아스가 말했다. "내 딸아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 복을 주시기를 바란다! 너는 전에도 나오미에게 변함없는 사랑을 보여 주었는데, 지금은 그보다 더 큰 사랑을 보여 주는구나. 너는 부자든 가난하든 젊은 남자와 결혼하려고 할 수도 있었는데, 그렇게 하지 않았다.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Bendita [seja] você {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}, minha filha! Você tornou esta sua última lealdade melhor que a primeira, não indo atrás dos moços, quer pobres, quer ricos.
pt.B: Ele disse: "Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} a abençoe, minha filha! Esta lealdade que você mostrou agora é ainda maior que a de antes, pois você não foi procurar marido entre os rapazes, fossem pobres ou ricos.
pt.R: Boaz disse: "Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoe você, minha filha! Antes você foi bondosa e leal com Noemi, e agora está sendo ainda mais bondosa e leal. Você poderia ter tentado se casar com um homem mais jovem, rico ou pobre, mas não fez isso.

am.L: እርሱም አለ፦ «ልጄ ሆይ፣ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} የተባረክሽ ነሽ፤ ድሀም ሆነ ባለ ጠጋ ጎበዛዝትን ባለመከተልሽ፣ የኋለኛውን ጽኑ ፍቅርሽን ከፊተኛው ይልቅ አሳመርሽው።
am.B: እርሱም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ልጄ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይባርክሽ! ድሀም ሆነ ሀብታም ባል ለማግኘት ጎበዛዝትን አልተከተልሽም፤ ስለዚህ አሁን ያሳየሽው ጽኑ ፍቅር ቀድሞ ካሳየሽው ይበልጣል።
am.R: ቦዔዝም እንዲህ አለ፦ «ልጄ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይባርክሽ! ቀድሞ ለኑኃሚን ጽኑ ፍቅር አሳይተሻል፤ አሁን ደግሞ ከዚያ የሚበልጥ ጽኑ ፍቅር እያሳየሽ ነው። ሀብታምም ሆነ ድሀ፣ ከአንድ ወጣት ጋር ለመጋባት መሞከር ትችዪ ነበር፤ ግን አላደረግሽውም።

hi.L: और उसने कहा, "मेरी बेटी, तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर से धन्य हो! तुमने अपने इस बाद के अटल प्रेम को पहले वाले से भी बढ़कर किया है, क्योंकि तुम जवानों के पीछे नहीं गईं, चाहे कंगाल हों या धनी।
hi.B: उसने कहा, "मेरी बेटी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें आशीष दें! अब जो कृपा तुमने दिखाई है, वह पहले वाली से भी बड़ी है, क्योंकि तुमने पति के लिए जवानों की ओर नहीं देखा, चाहे वे कंगाल हों या धनी।
hi.R: बोअज़ ने कहा, "मेरी बेटी, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें आशीष दें! तुमने पहले नाओमी पर कृपा दिखाई थी, और अब तुम उससे भी बड़ी कृपा दिखा रही हो। तुम किसी जवान आदमी से, चाहे वह धनी हो या ग़रीब, विवाह करने का प्रयत्न कर सकती थीं, पर तुमने ऐसा नहीं किया।

ru.L: И сказал он: «Благословенна ты {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, дочь моя! Ты сделала эту последнюю неизменную любовь лучше первой, тем что не пошла за юношами, ни за бедным, ни за богатым.
ru.B: Он сказал: «Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благословит тебя, дочь моя! Эта милость, которую ты проявила сейчас, больше той, что ты проявила прежде: ведь ты не стала искать себе мужа среди юношей, ни бедных, ни богатых.
ru.R: Вооз сказал: «Пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благословит тебя, дочь моя! Ты и прежде проявляла милость к Ноемини, а теперь проявляешь ещё большую. Ты могла бы постараться выйти замуж за кого-нибудь помоложе, бедного или богатого, но не сделала этого.

uk.L: І сказав він: «Благословенна ти від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, доню моя! Ти вчинила свою останню незмінну любов кращою за першу, бо не пішла за юнаками, чи то бідними, чи то багатими.
uk.B: Він сказав: «Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} благословить тебе, доню моя! Ця незмінна любов, яку ти виявила тепер, більша за ту, що ти виявила раніше, бо ти не шукала собі чоловіка серед юнаків, ні бідних, ні багатих.
uk.R: Вооз сказав: «Нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} благословить тебе, доню моя! Раніше ти виявила вірну любов до Ноомі, а тепер виявляєш ще більшу вірну любов. Ти могла б спробувати вийти заміж за молодшого чоловіка, багатого чи бідного, але не зробила цього.

ja.L: そして彼は言った。「わたしの娘よ、あなたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祝福された者だ。あなたは、貧しい者であれ富んだ者であれ、若い男たちの後を追わず、この後の誠実を、初めの[誠実]よりもさらに良いものとした。
ja.B: ボアズは言った。「娘さん、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたを祝福してくださるように。あなたが今示した誠実は、前に示したものよりもさらに大きい。貧しくても富んでいても、夫を求めて若い男たちのところへ行こうとはしなかったのだから。
ja.R: ボアズは言いました。「娘さん、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたを祝福してくださるように。あなたは前にもナオミに誠実を尽くしたが、今、それよりもっと大きな誠実を示してくれた。金持ちでも貧しくても、若い男と結婚しようとすることもできたのに、あなたはそうしなかった。

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyalty and kindness beyond what duty asks
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) means loyal, faithful love, kindness that keeps faith with those one is bound to and goes beyond what is owed. It is the word Naomi used when she prayed for her daughters-in-law (1:8) and the word for the LORD's love in Exodus 34:6.

decisions.choice: the latter better than the first: two acts of loyalty
alternatives: the first: her kindness to her dead husband (1:8)
decisions.reason: The first act of faithful love is most likely Ruth's leaving her own land to care for Naomi (2:11; 1:16-17). The latter is this night's request: instead of choosing a husband for herself, she has asked the family's redeemer to marry her, so that her dead husband's name and Naomi's family line may go on (4:10).

decisions.choice: not going after the young men: not looking for a husband of her own age
decisions.reason: "Going after" a man means seeking him as a husband. Boaz's words suggest he is older than Ruth. "Whether poor or rich" means any young man at all: she was free to look for love or for wealth, and chose family loyalty instead.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is rendered as in Exodus 34:6 and Deuteronomy: "steadfast love" at Literal, "faithful love" at Balanced and Readable, which shows both the loyalty and the warmth of the word.

decisions.choice: to Naomi before
decisions.reason: Readable names Naomi as the one Ruth first showed faithful love to (decision m2), and puts "going after the young men" as trying to marry a younger man (decision m3).

decisions.choice: looked to the young men for a husband
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "going after" the young men means (decision m3).

decisions.choice: "fadhili" for chesed here, between people
decisions.reason: As agreed for Ruth: here chesed is Ruth's loyal kindness to her family and to Boaz, and "fadhili" is the Swahili word for kindness shown between people; 1:8 and 2:20, where the LORD's love is spoken of, keep "upendo usiokoma".

decisions.choice: "lòng nhân từ" for Ruth's *hesed*
decisions.reason: The Joshua–Ruth terms note gives "lòng nhân từ" for *hesed* between people. At 1:8 the same word was given as "tình yêu thương thành tín" because one sentence joins the LORD's love and the daughters-in-law's; here it is Ruth's alone. A reviewer may prefer one word for both places.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (Readable "변함없는 사랑") for Ruth's *hesed*
decisions.reason: The same words as in 1:8 and 2:20, so that the reader sees the book's key word come back, now said of Ruth.

decisions.choice: lealdade (L, B); bondosa e leal (R)
decisions.reason: Here chesed (m1) is Ruth's, shown to her family, so it takes the wording set for chesed between people in 1:8 of this book and in 1 and 2 Samuel (1 Samuel 20:8; 2 Samuel 9:1): "lealdade" at Literal and Balanced, "bondosa e leal" at Readable. "Amor" would suggest romance in a scene where Boaz praises her loyalty, not her feeling for him.

decisions.choice: hesed between people: "अटल प्रेम" (Literal); "कृपा" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Here hesed is Ruth's loyal kindness, so the Pentateuch note's wording for hesed between people applies: "अटल प्रेम" at Literal, "कृपा" at Balanced and Readable, as in 1:8.

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь" (Literal); "милость" (Balanced, Readable)
alternatives: "верная любовь" at Balanced and Readable, as the English "faithful love"
decisions.reason: This is Ruth's hesed, shown by one person to others; the Pentateuch note renders hesed between people "неизменная любовь" at Literal and "милость" at Balanced and Readable, and Ruth follows it. The English keeps one wording for God's hesed and Ruth's; Russian, by the note, marks the difference.

decisions.choice: Ruth's chesed "誠実" at every level, as between people in 1:8
decisions.reason: Kept as the word for loyal love between people through the book.

records.literal_gloss: And now, my daughter, do not fear; all that you say I will do for you, for knows all [the] gate of my people that a woman of worth you [are].

en.L: And now, my daughter, do not be afraid. All that you say I will do for you, for all the gate of my people knows that you are a woman of worth.
en.B: So now, my daughter, have no fear. Whatever you ask, I will do for you. The whole town knows you are a woman of real worth.
en.R: Now, my daughter, do not be afraid. I will do everything you ask. All the people in our town know that you are a fine woman of good character.

sw.L: Na sasa, binti yangu, usiogope. Yote utakayosema nitakufanyia, kwa maana lango lote la watu wangu linajua ya kuwa wewe ni mwanamke mwema.
sw.B: Basi sasa, binti yangu, usiogope. Lolote utakaloomba nitakufanyia. Mji wote unajua kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mwema kweli.
sw.R: Sasa, binti yangu, usiogope. Nitafanya kila kitu unachoomba. Watu wote wa mji wetu wanajua kwamba wewe ni mwanamke mwema mwenye tabia njema.

es.L: Y ahora, hija mía, no temas. Todo lo que digas haré por ti, porque toda la puerta de mi pueblo sabe que eres una mujer de valor.
es.B: Así que ahora, hija mía, no tengas miedo. Haré por ti todo lo que me pidas. Todo el pueblo sabe que eres una mujer de gran valía.
es.R: Ahora, hija mía, no tengas miedo. Haré todo lo que me pidas. Toda la gente del pueblo sabe que eres una mujer buena y de buen carácter.

fr.L: Et maintenant, ma fille, ne crains pas. Tout ce que tu dis, je le ferai pour toi, car toute la porte de mon peuple sait que tu es une femme de valeur.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, ma fille, n’aie pas peur. Tout ce que tu demandes, je le ferai pour toi. Toute la ville sait que tu es une femme de grande valeur.
fr.R: Maintenant, ma fille, n’aie pas peur. Je ferai tout ce que tu demandes. Tous les gens de notre ville savent que tu es une femme bonne et courageuse.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, con gái ta, đừng sợ. Mọi điều con nói, ta sẽ làm cho con, vì cả cổng thành của dân ta đều biết con là một người phụ nữ đức hạnh.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, con gái ta, đừng sợ gì cả. Con xin điều gì, ta sẽ làm cho con. Cả thành đều biết con là một người phụ nữ thật đức hạnh.
vi.R: Bây giờ, con gái ta, đừng sợ. Ta sẽ làm mọi điều con xin. Mọi người trong thành chúng ta đều biết con là một người phụ nữ tốt, có phẩm cách.

ko.L: 이제 내 딸아, 두려워하지 마라. 네가 말하는 것은 무엇이든 내가 너를 위해 하겠다. 내 백성의 성문에 있는 모든 사람이 네가 현숙한 여자인 것을 안다.
ko.B: 이제 내 딸아, 걱정하지 마라. 네가 부탁하는 것은 무엇이든 내가 들어주겠다. 이 성읍 사람들은 모두 네가 훌륭한 여자인 것을 알고 있다.
ko.R: 이제 내 딸아, 두려워하지 마라. 네가 부탁하는 것은 무엇이든 해 주겠다. 우리 성 사람들은 모두 네가 착하고 훌륭한 여자라는 것을 알고 있다.

pt.L: E agora, minha filha, não tenha medo. Tudo o que você disser, eu farei por você, pois toda a porta do meu povo sabe que você é uma mulher de valor.
pt.B: Agora, minha filha, não tenha medo. Farei por você tudo o que me pedir. A cidade inteira sabe que você é uma mulher virtuosa, de valor.
pt.R: Agora, minha filha, não tenha medo. Vou fazer tudo o que você me pedir. Todo o povo da nossa cidade sabe que você é uma mulher virtuosa e de bom caráter.

am.L: አሁንም ልጄ ሆይ፣ አትፍሪ፤ የምትዪውን ሁሉ አደርግልሻለሁ፤ የሕዝቤም በር ሁሉ አንቺ ብርቱ ሴት እንደ ሆንሽ ያውቃልና።
am.B: እንግዲህ ልጄ፣ አትፍሪ። የምትጠይቂውን ሁሉ አደርግልሻለሁ። ምግባረ መልካምና የተከበርሽ ሴት እንደ ሆንሽ የከተማው ሰው ሁሉ ያውቃል።
